title: Nourishing Juicy Dutch Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Dutch stew made with pork, orange juice, and spices, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dairy-free friendly dish is slow-cooked to perfection in a bamboo tray.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bamboo tray, combine the pork, onion, carrots, potatoes, garlic, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the orange juice and red wine, then pour the mixture over the pork and vegetables.
Cover the bamboo tray with aluminum foil and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the tray from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
